method.class: Influence-guided outcome-flip sensitivity analysis of regularized Bradley-Terry rankings, verified by independent exact refits
method.description: {"aggregation": "Within episode equal mean of three nonzero edit budgets (1/3 each); equal seeds within case (1/3 production, identity smoke); Arena single crowd case identity; NBA equal seasons (1/3 search,1/5 final); equal family weights1/2,1/2. Each Arena seed weight1/6, each NBA search seed-case1/18, final1/30 before budget. Random baselines average streams first (4 search,8 final,1 smoke). All failed/missing episodes retain zero score/baseline/displacement and influence_error=control_error=1, validity/correct=0 at original weights. Method-audit failure retains zero candidate score/displacement and influence_error1. Flags are conjunctions, not means. No survivor renormalization.", "audits": "Independent trusted Newton fitting max100 iterations, max35 line-search backtracks, gradient infinity norm <2e-7; ridge1; candidate scores/audit derivatives/directional influences/prefix shift arithmetic allclose atol2e-5 rtol2e-4 (scores) or3e-3 (derivatives). Eight deterministic evenly spaced audit rows; finite difference epsilon1e-3, derivative allclose atol2e-5 rtol3e-3. This verifies executable influence arithmetic and independent fit/selection outputs, not hidden candidate internals. Nonlinear exact-refit prediction discrepancy norm/(1+norm) is reported as influence_error, not a superiority or linear-accuracy threshold.", "baselines": "Uniform random eligible flips; degree-sum quartile-stratified random flips matching each prefix of ACTUAL candidate selected row degree bins (approximate exposure matching, not exact endpoint matching); smallest absolute fitted matchup margin heuristic. Equal edit budgets, observed inputs and fixed random streams; baselines receive no candidate-only feedback. Streams seeded episode_seed+8371; actual degree matching seed+72831; grouped bootstrap seed+49207. Candidate may select alternative nested feasible sets; numerical directional influence/audit calculations and predicted prefix shifts must remain genuine.", "controls": "Canonical controls declared before scoring: (1) evaluator copy/no-op refit identical scores atol1e-9; (2) evaluator constant-zero predictor must be rejected by known nonzero exact-refit shift >.01 on explicitly synthetic 3-game 2-participant diagnostic, never substituted for real-data evidence; (3) rotate eligible directional priorities by one, require nonidentity priorities, different selected row set AND nonidentical refitted coefficients atol1e-9; matched budgets, no superiority gate; vacuity retains failed/inconclusive control; (4) immediately after required reset, analyze token input without data returns exactly error:no_data so previously legal state cannot be reused. Four control types weight1/4 each, each has one conjunction assertion. No controls expose labels, metrics or reference results via candidate RPC.", "deadlines": "One invocation deadline starts before loading, subtract conservative startup allowance120s search/300s final, reserve finish60s/120s. All episode resets globally reserve2s plus8s worst-case overhead each, including sequential candidate+worker termination/reap/stderr teardown. Each production episode reserves reference four methods30s each, candidate30s, scoring/controls/uncertainty90s search (=240 productive allowance); final90s each reference/candidate and210s scoring (=660). Ref methods have individual work alarms; parent reference worker total122/362 bounds, with explicit3s dispatch slack. Same candidate30/90 allowance per method, fixed estimator and edits. Each remaining reset reservation is retained on timeout. No canonical minimum productive baseline time exists. Actual productive reference work is measured excluding startup/imports/reset/output. Reduced smoke120s total subtracts2s startup,3s finish, reset2s+overhead2s each, reference individual1s/total5s, candidate1s, scoring4s with1 replicate; same cases/order/operations/loading/imports/isolation. Smoke does not attest production feasibility.", "final_correct": "Separately require all final cases/seeds/transcript and the same operational/scientific validity checks on sealed data. No comparative-superiority requirement. Final claim assessment uses paired effects/uncertainty and manuscript review; unsubstantiated superiority claims must be removed, not retroactively made search vetoes. Paper novelty/acceptance is NOT automated by numeric correct.", "limitations": "Operational proxy does not itself write/review the required conference PDF/LaTeX/checklist, assess novelty, inspect forbidden literature, prove opaque hidden mechanisms or establish causality across unequal comparison graphs. Publication requires human/scientific evidence review of actual manuscript and reproducibility artifacts. No held-out predictive-target task, adaptation requirement or learning/state-hash gate is invented. Methods optimize feasible observed-outcome perturbations, not historical misconduct. Fixed regularization, fractional ties, graph coverage, coarse degree matching and fixed intervention plans in bootstrap bound interpretation. Final data/outcomes cannot be used for search tuning.", "operational": "Linux x86-64 CPython3.11-3.13 (draft tested3.12), libseccomp.so.2, Landlock ABI>=3 for native validation; no GPU. 4 CPU cores/8GiB aggregate, at most2 active compute cores/threads and4GiB per role. Explicit thread environment, native/trusted subprocess address-space limits and all-thread CPU ceiling ceil(2*plane_wall), killable monotonic wall transport. Harness owns isolated production quotas. Native candidate has clean allowlisted environment, private copied single-file source and Landlock filesystem/seccomp network isolation; no evaluator resources/results/credentials mount. Only fixed proxy path plus socket authenticates in-process broker loading; proxy calls use bounded alarm, never child-launched. Final standalone requires own file, own resources and installed dependencies/harness only.", "operations_per_episode": {"analyze": 1, "download_chunk_max": 16, "reset": 1, "reset_probe_analyze_no_data": 1, "upload_chunk_max": 16, "upload_commit": 1, "upload_start": 1}, "rpc_derivation": "37 per episode using declared maximum 16 input and 16 output chunks, including setup/commit even for one chunk. Search 4 cases x3 seeds x37=444. Final 6 cases x3 seeds x37=666. No replay, retries, export/import state transfer, extra training or diagnostic resets. Evaluator-only copy/constant/permutation/refit/bootstrap operations use zero broker calls; reset control is the counted probe. Mock maximum transcript and scheduler/failure tests precede production.", "scientific_workload": "Arena: all 14272 search and 43205 final usable comparisons; NBA all unique games in 2006-2008 search and 2011-2015 final, season-specific participant universes. No Elo inputs. Sum logistic loss plus 0.5*L2 norm squared, ridge=1 for participant and optional home coefficients, centered participant scores; ties y=.5 included in fitting but cannot be edited. Fractions .001,.005,.01 of ALL usable rows, floor to integer, binary outcome flips, distinct nested prefix sets. A zero positive-budget edit count is invalid. Deterministic tie order is participant index in lexicographically sorted source names.", "search_correct": "Complete planned search reset transcript; valid bounded protocol and content-provenance integrity; feasible actual nested row edits; genuine numerically audited influence arithmetic; successful converged independent fits, required baselines and all nonvacuous controls; complete finite fixed-weight evidence; no isolation/leakage/resource violation. No large-sensitivity or baseline-superiority threshold. scientific_valid records mandatory estimator/method/control completeness; correct additionally requires operational/integrity completion. Eligible candidates ranked descending combined_score. A schema-valid state_changed or other self-report never contributes evidence.", "uncertainty": "Arena raw-document connected components and NBA unique games are grouped bootstrap units within each fixed panel, 10 search and30 final replicates per case/seed (1 smoke). Bootstrap original and fixed candidate/baseline nested interventions paired under identical group multiplicity weights; all random streams participate. Report 2.5/97.5 percentile rank intervals and paired candidate-minus-baseline effects. Failed required refits/resamples preserve entire episode worst-case evidence rather than intervals over survivors. Three seeds are algorithmic variation, not independent datasets. Sports conclusions are descriptive of fixed seasons, not causal effects of design.", "wire": "Only finite inline JSON lines, no paths or shared files. little-endian float64 observed [n,4] a,b,y,z, maximum input/output decoded size 16MiB each in candidate RAM, chunk 1MiB max, maximum 16 chunks each direction; participant cap256, n cap524288. Every actual line plus representative request_id/payload/error envelope and LF framing is serialized and checked <8MiB locally and strictly <64MiB harness limit. Full-sized representative base64 chunks preflight at 1398185 bytes or less including line metadata; larger framing has more than 56MiB unused harness headroom."}

protocol.promotion_rule: Development-only integrity-eligible ranking by descending combined_score, ties earlier submission then digest. At most three complete search submissions, one frozen sealed final invocation; harness exclusively owns promotion/freezing/publication. No comparative threshold, final-feedback tuning, replay or retries.

search_proxies.name: smaller_content_panel
search_proxies.preserves: Real crowdsourced preferences, normalized document groups, genuine binary flips and independent fixed-L2 BT refits, all four controls and both evaluation designs.
search_proxies.omits: Remaining sealed Arena groups and later NBA seasons; cannot establish temporal generalization or publication-quality evidence alone.

search_proxies.name: lighter_uncertainty
search_proxies.preserves: Fixed paired group bootstrap, fixed weights, matched edit budgets and all planned cases/seeds.
search_proxies.omits: Final uses 8 instead of4 random streams,30 instead of10 resamples and five instead of three sports seasons.

search_visible: Search scalar metrics and correctness, validated search-only solution evidence; fixed bounded failure categories. Raw worker stderr is repair-only under exact drafting/qualification flags.
Observed search episode comparison endpoints/outcomes and public workload/model settings through documented RPC only.
final_sealed: Final resource panels, manifests, seed constants, reference fits, metrics, correctness, controls and solution evidence are sealed until freeze and never optimization feedback.
During final execution candidate receives only observed final comparisons and plane-independent workload/model inputs, never held-out answers, scores or baseline outputs.

required_evidence: A complete research paper, PDF and LaTeX source in the latest officially released NeurIPS main-conference template available when preparing the submission; document the chosen edition and comply with its actual page limit and required checklist. Include abstract, introduction, genuinely read related work, intervention/model methods, real-data experiments, uncertainty, discussion, limitations and references. Obtain and record official template provenance downstream; no template or completed paper is claimed to exist at design time.

Real results on both the crowdsourced Arena panel and season-specific NBA panels, including every declared case/seed/budget, baseline stream and control, with normalized edit-cost definitions, why two different designs are comparable, graph/participant coverage and clear limits from unequal data volumes, temporal change, ties, home advantage, regularization and non-causal cross-design comparisons. Report null and adverse results equally. Do not imply that these datasets represent all leaderboards or identify malicious behavior.

Verified pinned-source checksums and licenses, raw-data acquisition instructions, evaluator-owned source IDs and row provenance, normalization specification, complete raw-document/example SHA-256 manifests and demonstrated search/final content disjointness before feature extraction. Document reciprocal NBA rows, excluded invalid records, connectedness and split-induced selection. Raw data stays in working data storage, not the code repository or paper submission; do not redistribute private split material or unnecessary text. Source checksums quoted in task.md are expected values, not design-time verification evidence.

Reproducible genuine candidate influence computation and trusted independent Bradley-Terry reference/refit code; fixed estimator and edit-feasibility policy; finite-difference and actual-refit audits; matched-budget baseline/control results including rejected vacuous permutations and reset-state tests. Pairwise comparative claims require the corresponding baseline contrasts and uncertainty. Missing or failed evidence retains finite worst-case values, full fixed weights and explicit failure status. No comparison advantage, stability conclusion or causal alignment result may be inferred from an incomplete or vacuous control.

Separate reports of scientific validity, search eligibility and final claim assessment, including exact search and final correct predicates, score hierarchy and weights, predeclared tie policy, all three-or-fewer search submissions and failures, frozen candidate digest/configuration, final unsealing chronology and the single final invocation. Novelty and publication standards are not post hoc search thresholds. State which narrower claims remain justified if comparisons are inconclusive.

Downstream contract preflight with canonical task digest, actual source/dependency provenance and synchronized artifact hashes; exact production/smoke reset arrays matching case/seed cardinality and order globally across clients/restarts; no unplanned resets or replays; actual largest production request/response JSON serialization sizes including UTF-8, base64, metadata, envelope and framing; bounded candidate-RAM chunk sessions; and fully counted max_candidate_rpc_calls covering resets, stale-token checks, chunks, failures and retries. No shared filesystem or path-based RPC. This design specifies required evidence; it does not claim preflight has already passed.

Offline smoke validation for both planes through unchanged loader/import/device/mount/broker/update/metric paths with reduced work, empty HOME and the exact smoke transcripts. Keep smoke validation distinct from successful full production completion. Provide harness allocation/isolation evidence, all-thread CPU policy, actual monotonic times and cleanup/cancellation logs. Clearly distinguish enforced wall/RPC/resource ceilings from advisory candidate-internal iteration counts; do not present reported iteration counters as a trusted hard operation cap.

All paper numbers, plots and tables must come from actual recorded task runs with scripts mapping each output to inputs, seeds, configuration and trusted metrics. Provide code, standard requirements.txt versions, offline wheel/platform instructions, data-fetch commands, reproduction commands and measured or honestly labeled estimated runtimes. Log failures, abandoned approaches, unfinished analyses and LLM assistance. Never fabricate checkpoints, measurements, successful launches, read literature or completed validation.

Respect the canonical independence restriction: never identify, guess, search for, access or use the prohibited prior paper or any related mirror, abstract, discussion, reproduction or code. Use only explicitly allowed starter readings and unrelated permitted sources, avoid broad searches likely to encounter forbidden material, and immediately stop and record any accidental encounter with location and amount read. Network is restricted to listed data acquisition, permissible literature and dependency installation; no paid APIs. Finish research, experiments, writing and reproduction within the one-week task budget.
